HBO Max Reddit account compromised to serve ClickFix attacks
stories.abstract: Threat actors compromised the official HBO Max Reddit account to distribute malicious advertisements. These ads directed users to ClickFix pages, which employ social engineering tactics to trick Windows and macOS users into executing information-stealing malware as part of a broader malvertising campaign.
stories.why: High-profile account takeovers are being leveraged to bypass user skepticism and deliver sophisticated malware payloads via trusted platforms.

Japan's Digital Agency says VPN flaw exposed 246,000 personnel records
stories.abstract: Japan's Digital Agency confirmed a security breach involving a VPN vulnerability that resulted in the unauthorized access of personal data belonging to approximately 246,000 government employees.
stories.why: VPNs remain a primary target for initial access; this incident highlights the critical need for rigorous patching and monitoring of edge infrastructure.

mySCADA myPRO Manager
stories.abstract: Two critical vulnerabilities in mySCADA myPRO Manager versions 2.1 and earlier allow unauthenticated attackers to execute privileged management commands or transmit unauthorized SMS messages via connected GSM modems, posing significant risks to industrial control environments.
stories.why: These flaws permit remote, unauthenticated control over critical infrastructure management interfaces, potentially leading to unauthorized system manipulation or operational disruption.
stories.action: Update mySCADA myPRO Manager to a version beyond 2.1.

stories.abstract: A Thai internet service provider suffered a breach after attackers exploited a Fortinet vulnerability. The intruders deployed various scripts to conduct reconnaissance, perform brute-force attacks, and escalate privileges within the network infrastructure.
stories.why: This incident highlights the ongoing risk of unpatched edge devices serving as initial access vectors for sophisticated network intrusions.

Malicious Twitch Browser Extension Leaks OAuth Tokens From Nearly 31,000 Users
stories.abstract: A browser extension named Twitch Enhanced Viewer | JeetBot has been caught exfiltrating Twitch OAuth session tokens to a third-party bot service. The malicious add-on, available on both Chrome and Firefox stores, compromised approximately 31,000 users.
stories.why: Stolen OAuth tokens allow attackers to hijack user sessions, bypass authentication, and perform unauthorized actions on behalf of the victim.
stories.action: Uninstall the Twitch Enhanced Viewer | JeetBot extension and revoke your Twitch session tokens immediately.

Swiss court sentences 52-year-old Ukrainian ransomware dev to nearly 13 years in the cooler
stories.abstract: A Swiss court has sentenced a 52-year-old Ukrainian national to nearly 13 years in prison. The individual was convicted of developing the malicious code behind the LockerGoga, MegaCortex, and Nefilim ransomware operations, which caused significant global damage.
stories.why: This highlights the successful international prosecution of core ransomware developers, potentially disrupting the operational capabilities of major cybercriminal syndicates.

Microsoft AI Code of Conduct Sets Cyberattack Boundaries, Chain of Command, Safety Constraints
stories.abstract: Microsoft has introduced a Humanist AI Code of Conduct to delineate the boundaries between legitimate defensive cybersecurity research and the development of offensive operational capabilities. The framework establishes specific safety constraints and internal oversight protocols for AI-driven security projects.
stories.why: It clarifies the ethical and operational limits for AI development in security, potentially influencing industry standards for responsible AI-assisted cyber research.

New York Seizes a Dozen Celebrity Deepfake Websites
stories.abstract: The Manhattan District Attorney’s Office has shut down 12 websites hosting non-consensual, hyper-realistic deepfake sexual imagery. The operation targeted platforms that collectively exploited the likenesses of approximately 1,200 individuals.
stories.why: This marks a significant legal escalation against the proliferation of AI-generated non-consensual intimate imagery and the platforms that facilitate its distribution.

AL26-020 - Vulnerabilities Impacting MikroTik RouterOS - CVE-2026-67276, CVE-2026-67277 and CVE-2026-86060
stories.abstract: The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security has issued an alert regarding three vulnerabilities in MikroTik RouterOS. These flaws, particularly dangerous when SSH services are internet-facing, include a critical missing authentication vulnerability currently tracked on the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
stories.why: These vulnerabilities allow unauthorized access to network infrastructure, and two are already being actively exploited in the wild.
stories.action: Update MikroTik RouterOS to the latest version and restrict SSH access to trusted networks.

stories.title: $1 Million Sandbox Challenge Uncovers Linux Kernel Flaws
stories.abstract: The $1 Million Sandbox Challenge has successfully identified multiple vulnerabilities within the Linux kernel. The influx of reports generated by AI-assisted research has overwhelmed Vercel's security team, necessitating the implementation of automated triage processes to manage the high volume of incoming vulnerability disclosures.
stories.why: Automated vulnerability discovery and reporting are significantly increasing the operational burden on security teams, requiring more robust ingestion and triage workflows.
